description: Choose which events a webhook endpoint receives. The address is changed with change_webhook_endpoint_url instead, and the account owner confirms the new one. Only the account owner's API keys and connected apps can change webhooks.

events.description: status_changed: a transfer's status changed. final_state: a transfer reached a final state, such as credited or returned. checks_ended: automatic checks on a transfer ended before a final state, including when it was archived. A delivered event's type is the name with transfer. in front, for example transfer.status_changed.

name: update_webhook_endpoint
title: Change a webhook endpoint's events
